disclaimer: Hand-picked synthetic examples for the live demo, not a benchmark. They are excluded from every accuracy number. Dollar figures are computed from the documents shown; no live API calls.
expected_color_note: expected_color is the semantic action token (ok/dispute/appeal/ask/insufficient); status_color is the literal card colour (green/red/amber). amber = human review or missing evidence.
owed_note: verified_owed_cents is null when the amount is not verified. In that case expected_owed_cents is only the bill's current ask and must never be displayed as the amount owed.

products.drex: types the yes/no/choice questions and returns calibrated probabilities; code, not Drex, sets every dollar
products.ndi: splits the packet and extracts bill/EOB/denial fields with page citations for evidence crops
products.search: recorded live for SC-05 and SC-04 control; other cases have no recorded Search chain
products.browser: recorded live for SC-05: public Carelon guideline stand-in; proposal approval pending; .gov blocked

cases.title: ER visit · one knee MRI
cases.story: Two identical knee MRI lines on the same day at the same time; the visit record documents one scan. Code removes the duplicate's patient share. A human signs the dispute.

products.name: drex
products.role: answers dup_L3 and action_L3 with calibrated probabilities

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts both MRI rows and the one-scan remark with page boxes

products.name: search
products.role: planned (T3 pending): would quote the visit note that documents a single scan

cases.title: Office visit · one facial wound repair
cases.story: One facial wound repair entered as four units. CMS MUE for 12011 is 1/day (MAI 2) and the record documents one repair. Code keeps one unit and disputes the excess.

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts the four-unit quantity and the one-repair note

cases.title: Office follow-up · routine labs
cases.story: A routine follow-up with five lab lines; every charge matches its EOB row. The clean control stays green and nothing is disputed.

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts all six lines and their EOB matches

products.name: search
products.role: planned (T3 pending): would answer whether any lab was repeated

cases.title: Statement without an EOB · denial reason missing
cases.story: No EOB was supplied and the denial notice states no reason; one charge also lacks a service date. BillProof asks for the missing documents instead of guessing an amount.

products.name: drex
products.role: flags missing_data and refuses to price an unverified balance

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts the bill and shows the denial notice has no reason text

products.name: search
products.role: recorded live negative control: no applicable supporting plan clause; draft stays an information request

cases.title: Emergency CT denial · appeal with the ED record
cases.story: The plan denied an emergency CT as not medically necessary, but the notice does not address the enclosed ED record. The record supports an appeal; a human signs it.

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts the ED record and the CO-50 notice

products.name: search
products.role: recorded live: quotes plan section 5.2 page 2 and ED record; Drex document-support probability changes from 0.001 to 0.9996

products.name: browser
products.role: recorded live public Carelon guideline stand-in: two verbatim quotes, 31 seconds, $0.009; proposal approval pending

cases.title: Emergency visit · out-of-network clinician
cases.story: Out-of-network emergency clinician. The EOB applies protected in-network cost sharing, yet the bill adds $350. Balance billing goes to a human, never an auto-approval.

products.name: drex
products.role: answers nsa and routes to human review

products.name: ndi
products.role: extracts the out-of-network flag and protected cost share

products.name: browser
products.role: planned (T3 pending): would read the No Surprises Act emergency balance-billing page; .gov sources are blocked and no page is cached
